SASKPOWER-SUPPLIED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
STANDARD RATE This rate is for metered non-residential and non-farm loads greater than 75 kilovolt
amperes (kVA) and up to and including 3,000 kVA, served through SaskPower-supplied
transformation and to which no other rates apply. Rate Codes* E05 E06
Effective February 1, 2026 (Urban) (Rural)
Basic monthly charge $75.85 $75.85
Demand Charge First 50 kVA/month $0 $0
Balance $/kVA $21.632 $21.632
Energy Charge First block kWh/month 16,750 kWh 15,500 kWh
First block (¢/kWh) 11.964¢ 11.964¢
Balance (¢/kWh) 7.504¢ 7.504¢
MINIMUM BILL The basic monthly charge plus $5.059/kVA of the maximum demand over 50 kVA
registered in the defined billing periods between May 1st to October 31st and
November 1st to April 30th.

SASKPOWER-SUPPLIED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
SMALL COMMERCIAL RATE This rate is for metered commercial and municipal loads up to and including 75 kilovolt
amperes (kVA) served through SaskPower-supplied transformation and to which no
other rates apply. Rate Codes* E75 E76
Effective February 1, 2026 (Urban) (Rural)
Supply voltage 25kV & less 25kV & less
Basic monthly charge $42.79 $42.79
Demand Charge First 50 kVA/month $0 $0
Balance $/kVA $20.788 $20.788
Energy Charge First block kWh/month 14,500 kWh 13,000 kWh
First block (¢/kWh) 15.602¢ 15.602¢
Balance (¢/kWh) 6.393¢ 6.393¢
MINIMUM BILL The basic monthly charge plus $5.059/kVA of the maximum demand over 50 kVA
registered in the defined billing periods between May 1st to October 31st and
November 1st to April 30th.

SASKPOWER-SUPPLIED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
NON-FARM IRRIGATION RATE
This rate is for non-farm irrigation loads served through SaskPower-supplied transformation for the annual pumping season between February 1 and Oct. 31.
Rate Code* E37
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic seasonal charge $283.78
Demand Charge $/HP/season $28.553
Energy Charge Energy charge (¢/kWh) 10.764¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic seasonal charge plus the demand charge. FOR LOADS IN EXCESS OF 3,000 KILOVOLT AMPERES (KVA)
For loads in excess of 3,000 kVA, a different rate structure will apply. Please see
Customer-Owned Transformation - Power Standard Rates.

SASKPOWER-SUPPLIED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
UNMETERED GENERAL SERVICE RATE
This rate is for unmetered miscellaneous loads where the electrical consumption is
constant or predictable.
Examples of this type of load include: Rest room lighting; telephone booths; school
warning lights; decorative lighting; automatic railroad crossing protection; and traffic
lights. Rate Code* E15
Effective February 1, 2026
Charge per 100 watt of connected load per month $4.697
MINIMUM BILL $22.08 per month.
UNMETERED GENERAL SERVICE RATE
This rate is for power supply units used for cable television. Rate Code* E16
Effective February 1, 2026
Charge per power supply unit per month $81.66
MINIMUM BILL $81.66 per month.

SASKPOWER-SUPPLIED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
UNMETERED CATV RECTIFIER RATE
This rate is for cable television rectifiers. Rate Code* E17
Effective February 1, 2026
Charge per 10 watt of connected load per month $1.713
MINIMUM BILL $34.21 per month for the sum of all rectifiers within a community.
UNMETERED X-RAY RATE
This rate is for X-rays of three kilovolt ampere (kVA) capacity or larger where dedicated
transformer capacity and service entrance is provided. Rate Code* E18
Flat rate Effective February 1, 2026
Charge/kVA of installed transformer capacity/month $4.687

SASKPOWER-SUPPLIED
TRANSFORMATION RATES
GENERAL SERVICE DIESEL RATE
This rate is for metered non-residential and non-farm diesel loads including federal,
provincial, and local community government accounts. Rate Code* E35
Effective February 1, 2026
Basic monthly charge $46.36
Energy Charge First 650 kWh/month (¢/kWh) 16.086¢
Balance (¢/kWh) 55.413¢
MINIMUM BILL
The basic monthly charge.
